impact: Small, routine trades with no direct read on Clement's holdings; the Cisco buy comes ahead of Cisco's Nov 12 earnings, a read for NOK and telecom equipment.
summary: Rep. Gilbert Cisneros (D) disclosed selling Nvidia and Uber shares and buying Cisco shares, each in the $1,001 to $15,000 range, traded Oct 20 and filed Nov 11, per House disclosures tracked by Unusual Whales.
title: Rep. Cisneros (D) sells NVDA and UBER, buys CSCO (K-$15K each)
